['Biesterfeld AG '].company_description: The Biesterfeld AG is the strategic holding of the Biesterfeld group of companies, a distributor for plastics and chemicals with subsidiaries in more than 30 countries worldwide. The headquarters of the family-owned company is in Hamburg, Germany.

['WMF W\u00fcrttembergische Metallwarenf.company_description: WMF (Württembergische Metallwarenfabrik) is a German tableware manufacturer, founded in 1853 in Geislingen an der Steige. The company is known for producing a wide range of high-quality kitchenware, cookware, and professional coffee machines for both private and professional use.
